assertions.statement: An authorized administrator can manage the device catalog, channel product rules, exact SKU mappings, and remark templates from the standalone Rental Configuration page.
XianGuanJia product and SKU identifiers and Xianyu item and SKU identifiers are persisted separately without fallback or title/text inference.
Every non-filtered durable channel order creates exactly one internal rental order immediately even when its remark, rental dates, or equipment model are incomplete.
Single-model products match by shop and Xianyu item id, while multi-model products require an exact synchronized XianGuanJia SKU match and never fall back to a product default.
Configured skipped products retain channel revenue and raw evidence but do not parse remarks, create reviews or internal rental orders, or generate schedules.
A later valid remark or model mapping updates the same unassigned internal order, while invalid remarks preserve the last valid plan.
Configuration and remark changes cannot overwrite assigned, dispatched, returned, inspected, replaced, or financially settled facts.
Historical reconciliation is idempotent and resumable, creates missing normal rental orders, skips only eligible configured products, and reports conflicts without deleting history.
The Rental Device page consumes the shared catalog for filtering and device creation but no longer exposes category or model quick-create controls.
The configuration experience covers light and dark themes, zh-CN and en locales, desktop and narrow layouts, and loading, empty, error, and permission states.
